1. Which of the following expressions are polynomials? If not give reason:
(i) 1/x² + 3x − 4

1. Which of the following expressions are polynomials? If not give reason:
(ii) x²(x − 1)

1. Which of the following expressions are polynomials? If not give reason:
(iii) (1/x)(x + 5)

1. Which of the following expressions are polynomials? If not give reason:
(iv) 1/x⁻² + 1/x⁻¹ + 7

1. Which of the following expressions are polynomials? If not give reason:
(v) √5 x² + √3 x + √2

1. Which of the following expressions are polynomials? If not give reason:
(vi) m² − ∛m + 7m − 10

2. Write the coefficient of x² and x in each of the following polynomials.
(i) 4 + (2/5)x² − 3x

2. Write the coefficient of x² and x in each of the following polynomials.
(ii) 6 − 2x² + 3x³ − √7 x

2. Write the coefficient of x² and x in each of the following polynomials.
(iii) πx² − x + 2

2. Write the coefficient of x² and x in each of the following polynomials.
(iv) √3 x² + √2 x + 0.5

2. Write the coefficient of x² and x in each of the following polynomials.
(v) x² − (7/2)x + 8
